historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the preliminary plans for Embarcadero Plaza by Lawrence Halprin & Associates with Mario J. Ciampi and John Bolles, submitted by the Redevelopment Agency.
The Art Commission approved the Phase III plans for the grand fountain sculpture of Embarcadero Plaza, after disapproving Phase I in August.

The Recreation and Park Commission made the first payment, $7,830, to Lawrence Halprin & Associates, John S. Bolles and Mario J. Ciampi, appointed as consultants to prepare schematic plans for the 4.04-acre Ferry Building Park.

After Lawrence Halprin and Mario Ciampi explained it, the Recreation and Park Commission approved in principle the preliminary design for Embarcadero Plaza, Phase 1-A, the Ferry Building Park, asking that tubbed plants or trees be set around the edge of the sunken brick area.
